name: Kagerou Project Love Love Dating Sim! Sensei, Please Touch Me ~There~!
source:
Have you ever wanted to date your teacher, but realized that it was illegal to do so? Well, with this Kagerou Project visual novel you can do just that! Your favorite characters are teachers who guide you through your day. Move along with them through your classes and learn the true meaning of love! It may be a bit bumpy at times, but everything works out well in the end! Love, drama, comedy- this game has it all! Be sure to check it out!

[From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/kagerou-love-love]Ren'py Archieves[/url]]
translation:
你是否想过和老师约会，却因为那是违法行为而放弃？在这部《阳炎计划》视觉小说中，你可以实现这个愿望！你喜欢的角色们会作为老师，在一天中陪伴并引导你。和她们一起上课，了解爱的真正含义吧！过程中也许会有些波折，但最终一切都会顺利解决！爱情、戏剧、喜剧——这部作品应有尽有，千万不要错过！

[摘自[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/kagerou-love-love]Ren'Py Archives[/url]]
